description: This file defines and manages operator scopes and method classifications for gateway operations, including scope resolution, method categorization, and authorization logic.

methods.name: resolveScopedMethod
methods.description: Resolves the scope of a given method, considering explicit, reserved, and plugin-defined scopes.

methods.name: isApprovalMethod
methods.description: Checks if a method is classified under the approval scope.

methods.name: isPairingMethod
methods.description: Checks if a method is classified under the pairing scope.

methods.name: isReadMethod
methods.description: Checks if a method is classified under the read scope.

methods.name: isWriteMethod
methods.description: Checks if a method is classified under the write scope.

methods.name: isNodeRoleMethod
methods.description: Checks if a method is a node role method.

methods.name: isAdminOnlyMethod
methods.description: Checks if a method requires admin scope.

methods.name: resolveRequiredOperatorScopeForMethod
methods.description: Resolves the minimal required scope for a method.

methods.name: resolveLeastPrivilegeOperatorScopesForMethod
methods.description: Returns the least privileged scopes that can perform the method.

methods.name: authorizeOperatorScopesForMethod
methods.description: Determines if provided scopes authorize the method, returning allowed status and missing scope if not.

methods.name: isGatewayMethodClassified
methods.description: Checks if a method is classified as a gateway method based on scope or node role.
